records.statement: Yamaha's 2027 YZ450FX owner's service manual lists cold valve clearances of 0.10–0.17 mm (0.0039–0.0067 in) intake and 0.15–0.22 mm (0.0059–0.0087 in) exhaust, cylinder bore 97.000–97.010 mm (3.8189–3.8193 in) (wear limit 97.060 mm (3.8213 in)), piston-to-cylinder clearance 0.010–0.045 mm (0.0004–0.0018 in) and a top-ring end gap limit of 0.55 mm (0.0217 in).
records.notes: Every spec-chapter value with a standard and/or limit (engine, wheels, brakes, suspension, chain, starter motor). Valve clearances are checked cold (room temperature) with the piston at TDC. Brake disc runout is as measured on the wheel; drive chain slack is measured on the maintenance stand. FX clutch uses a diaphragm-type spring (free height) instead of coil springs.
